title: Basal insulin recording
body:
Dears 

First of all, many thanks for all helps & support, I notice that in xdrip only we can add our Bolus units but not Basal units, pls we need a feature to add our Basal units as well to be reflected in the reports so we can track our records 

Right now I add my Lantus units as a bolus & I add a note indicating that it is Lantus unit but I know that is not the right way to do it

thanks

comments.body: What about converting your daily Lantus dose into a fake basal rate profile? (xDrip and most of the Nightscout infrastructure were never thought to be used by penners.)

Would be great to have this, as converting to fake rate doesn't help with tracking the injections especially if your dosage isn't the same every day.

To be honest the recording of pump rate seems a lot more redundant than manual dose recording

+1 I inject Lantus twice daily and checking the app helps if your not sure if you missed your alarm or not  ;) 
I was hoping to work on separating the IOB graph lines into separate lines based on insulin brand, however I think separating basal and bolus would be better. 
How would that look in the mongoDB as currently the documents look like this

```
{'_id': ObjectId('1b5ef688a8ef429b9eda5b01'), 'timestamp': 1597651201053.0, 'eventType': '<none>', 'enteredBy': 'xdrip', 'uuid': '1b5ef688-a8ef-429b-9eda-5b01f5f04dc8', 'insulin': 10, 'insulinInjections': '[{"insulin":"Lantus","units":10.0}]', 'created_at': '2020-08-17T08:00:01.000Z', 'sysTime': '2020-08-17T10:00:01.053+0200', 'utcOffset': 0}
{'_id': ObjectId('0c3d463feca04d7c9f1a26fb'), 'timestamp': 1598872163914.0, 'eventType': '<none>', 'enteredBy': 'xdrip', 'uuid': '0c3d463f-eca0-4d7c-9f1a-26fb83d9aab4', 'insulin': 2, 'insulinInjections': '[{"insulin":"Humalog","units":2.0}]', 'created_at': '2020-08-31T11:09:23.000Z', 'sysTime': '2020-08-31T13:09:23.914+0200', 'utcOffset': 0}
```


Not sure how that would look on the UI

@Abdullahsi Would you please have a look at the following, older, issue?
https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/1125

If you agree that this issue is a duplicate of that, would you please close this issue?
Otherwise, would you please explain the difference?
@Navid200 no this request is for non-pump users being able to record Lantus and/or other long lasting insulins and have them shown as basal

@vytux-com What is that statement based on?
I look at the title and the description in the first post of the two open issues and they look quite similar, if not identical.

I thought we could already enter basal into xDrip.
If we can, both issues should be closed.  If we cannot, one of them needs to be closed, and the other one precedes this one.

Please explain why we need two open issues for adding basal inputs to xDrip.

Closing this as it seems to be a duplicate.
Please explain why we need this issue to remain open if issue 1125 is also open and we can reopen this.
